headline: Post-FOMC relief rally lifts NQ toward session highs as oil retreats; Tail held in the watch band
body: The Federal Reserve raised its target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on September 16, its first increase since July 2023, on a unanimous 12-0 vote, with projections pointing to a further increase by year-end. Nasdaq-100 cash sold off sharply after the statement, trading down to 28,753.29 before recovering to close at 28,945.06, a genuine retracement that argues against a no-retracement regime. Overnight, Saudi Arabia signalled staged restoration of the drone-damaged East-West pipeline, sending WTI to about $100.70 (-1.7%) and Brent to about $103.54 (-2.2%). NQ futures trade near 29,571 (+1.07%) within roughly 20 points of the 29,591 session high, and VIX is near 16.0 (-9.7%). The directional grind and position at the session extreme are the main Tail amplifiers; decaying volatility, an orderly post-event path and a de-escalating oil supply story are the offsets. Stress remains elevated on a newly restarted hiking cycle, a 10-year yield near 5.00% and crude above $100.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed mostly in the low-to-watch Tail band, with one orange excursion to Tail 31% in the 19:00 UTC hour as the FOMC statement and press conference drove a sharp Nasdaq-100 sell-off toward 28,753. That move retraced into the cash close, and Tail fell back to 16-20% overnight. Stress decayed steadily from the high 70s before the decision to the low 60s this morning as volatility normalised and crude eased on Saudi pipeline repair guidance.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the watch band through the European morning, then maps conditional Tail into the block band for the 13:00 and 14:00 UTC hours, covering the 12:30 UTC US data cluster, the 13:30 UTC cash open and 14:00 UTC pending home sales. An aligned bullish regime running into the New York open is the configuration most capable of producing opening continuation with shallow pullbacks, so that window carries the peak conditional Tail of 26%. Conditional Tail then decays through the US afternoon, rises slightly into the 19:00 UTC power hour, and falls below the watch threshold overnight as the event stack clears. Confidence declines with distance from the evidence cutoff. Next-week US calendar items could not be verified with exact release times and are omitted rather than estimated.
